title: Set a pivot value
statement: Given a finite variable type, a pivot variable, a linear equation, and an assignment of field values to all variables, form a new assignment by changing only the pivot variable's value. Set that value to the equation's constant plus the sum, over all other variables, of the coefficient at that variable times its value in the original assignment.
hypotheses_covered: The variable type has decidable equality
